# Chartly

Chartly renders Chart.js configurations as PNG or SVG images and creates permanent chart URLs for sharing and embedding.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/chartly/.

## Actions

- **Create Permanent Chart**: Create a permanent Chartly URL from a Chart.js configuration.
- **Get Permanent Chart** (read-only): Download the PNG or SVG image for an existing permanent Chartly chart ID.
- **Render Chart** (read-only): Render a Chart.js configuration as a PNG or SVG downloadable image without creating a permanent Chartly URL.
